U.S. Department of Justice 

Office of the Solicitor General 

The Solicitor General

Washington, D.C. 20530 

October 30, 2019 

Honorable Scott S. Harris 
Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
Washington, D.C. 20543 

Re: Department of Homeland Security v. Vijayakumar Thuraissigiam, No. 19-161 

Dear Mr. Harris: 

On October 18, 2019, the Court granted the petition for a writ of certiorari in the above-

captioned case. The government's brief on the merits is currently due on December 2, 2019. 

Because of scheduling difficulties and the press of other matters before the Court, the 
parties respectfully request, under Rule 30.4 of the Rules of this Court, a 7-day extension of time, 
to and including December 9, 2019, within which to file the petitioner's opening brief and joint 
appendix; and a corresponding 7-day extension of time, to and including January 15, 2020, within 
which to file the respondent's brief. If those extensions are granted, the reply brief would be due 
on February 14, 2020. 

The parties have agreed on the schedule above, which is necessary to accommodate the 

litigation schedules of counsel. 

Sincerely, 

Noel J. Francisco 
Solicitor General
